title: Sculptural Restaurant & Bar
tagline: A sculptural journey from arrival to dining.
description: A restaurant and bar concept with a flowing, sculptural ceiling, warm amber light and dark reflective surfaces. The entrance and corridor introduce the same curved forms that continue into the dining space and bar, creating a connected visual journey.
role: Concept design and creative direction: spatial idea, atmosphere and art direction of the concept visuals. Self-initiated concept study, not a built project.
